layout.body:
Apartment For Sale
A great opportunity has just arisen to purchase a great four-bedroom apartment situated on the corner of Rock Street and Patrick Street. This apartment is very well located and is in close proximity to downtown. The main shopping and business areas are only a 20-minute bus-ride away and the apartment is nearby the new train terminal. We expect bidding to start at $500,000. If you would like to view the apartment, please come for a look any time between 10am and 5pm Friday, October 15th and Sunday, October 17th. It is not necessary to make an appointment.

questions.stem: If you would like to view the apartment, what must you do?

options.C: Visit the apartment during specified hours
options.D: Walk to the new train terminal

questions.analysis: If you would like to view the apartment, what must you do? 原文依据：please come for a look any time between 10am and 5pm Friday, October 15th and Sunday, October 17th. 请在 10 月 15 日周五至 10 月 17 日周日的上午 10 点到下午 5 点之间前来看房。 A：支付 50 万美元 → 错误 B：打电话预约 → 错误 C：在指定时间看房 → 正确 D：步行去新火车站 → 错误

questions.stem: What is the main advantage of the apartment mentioned?

options.A: The access to the bus terminal

questions.analysis: What is the main advantage of the apartment mentioned? 原文依据：close to downtown, 20-minute bus-ride to shopping areas, nearby the new train terminal. 靠近市中心，坐公交 20 分钟到商业区，靠近新火车站。 A：靠近巴士总站 → 错误 B：交通便利 → 正确 C：四间大卧室 → 错误 D：环境优美 → 错误
